## Summary

Describe the concern at a high level. Do not include exploit details, secrets, credentials, private metadata, or personal media.

## Affected area

- Login/session
- Sync/upload
- Vault/encryption
- Metadata export/import
- Android permissions
- Release/signing
- Other:

## Private disclosure needed?

If this requires private details, say so here and wait for maintainer guidance or use GitHub private vulnerability reporting if enabled.
